Summary: enterprise buyer (manufacturing + IIoT) evaluating Dedicated + Private for mission-critical operator-assist and predictive maintenance. Wants repeatable low-latency chat for operators on factory floor; reranking for anomaly alerts; long-term doc search for SOPs.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2025-11-04: Intro call (AE Maya) - high level use cases captured, VP Eng interested in reserved GPUs and SLA. Fireflies: FF-20260302-EDGEHAVEN-KICKOFF (see transcript).
- 2026-01-12: Architecture deep-dive with infra (SE Daniel) - discussed VPC-only deployment, HSM for keys, compliance constraints. Jira INFRA-4721 opened for network questions.
- 2026-02-20: Proof-of-concept scoping call - customer provided trace samples (avg token/sec ~ 3200 across mixed QPS), baseline latencies required: p50 < 80ms token, p95 < 250ms for short-chat flows.
- 2026-03-02: Internal Redwood sizing readout; proposed 4x A100-class GPUs for steady-state 60 QPS and 2x burst nodes for peak. Sent preliminary cost / throughput comparison (drive link).

Key technical notes / raw numbers:
- Workload mix: 65% short assistant chat (max prompt + response ~ 400 tokens), 25% doc search/embedding queries (batch embeddings), 10% heavy reranking/eval (long context up to 8k tokens).
- Observed traces: typical steady-state QPS 40-70, peak burst windows 160-220 QPS for 3-7 minute intervals. Customer wants headroom for 2x growth year-1.
- Target performance: per-request p50 generation latency <= 150ms for short-chat (end-to-end generation; token/sec and kv-cache impact to be validated), p95 <= 350ms. Throughput guarantee ask: sustained 60 QPS with 200 QPS 5-min burst.
- Token/sec baseline: steady-state 128k tokens/sec aggregate (est.), peak burst 480k tokens/sec.
- Preferred models: open Llama-variant quantized 8-bit for cost with fallback to fp16 variants for latency-critical paths. Must support automatic model fallback + routing.

Customer quotes / color: "We need predictable latency during shift changes — can't have ramp spikes. SLA critical." — CTO Priya Menon.
